input.prompt: One locked-camera documentary interview take from the supplied frame, same woman, face, hair, apron, background and warm window light. Preserve the reference skin texture without retouching. She remains seated with settled shoulders, hands resting in her lap below frame. Her eyes stay on one interviewer just camera-right; an occasional natural blink and small mouth movements accompany speech. Understated matter-of-fact delivery. Begin speaking immediately, without a preparatory smile or breath: "we use CREW now. everyone puts their availability on their phone." Finish the sentence once, then close her lips and listen quietly. No shoulder shrug, no sideways glance, no head sway, no exaggerated eyebrows, no zoom, no cut, no music, no captions, no logos.
